mapping_json.fidelity_notes: NEGATIVE-canon exemplar (negative=1, death_class extrinsic-no-lever) mapped honestly, not laundered: community verdict CONFIRMED — 'problems are purely mechanical... the numbers are not bad'. The stochastic-element identity is the SAME gap the elemental-hit docket filed (per-attack random-element-from-pool); wild-strike is the accrual instance that docket asked the steward to watch for, and it is gapped WORSE: there is no Combat-Focus-style pruning endpoint (the un-curated roulette IS the kit) and the roll ALSO selects among three secondary geometries. PHASE_MOMENTUM (deterministic element cycling) and ELEMENT_CONVERSION_MONO (Oro's forced-fire endpoint) are the two nearest engine expressions; both delete the roulette. Era 2.x CONFIRMED; 3.x era claims UNSUPPORTED (niche-build evidence only) — consistent with trap-canon status.
